templates.name: Medical Appointment Reminder
templates.description: Webhook-triggered SMS sequence at 72h, 24h, and 2h before appointments with Google Sheets logging. Skips full sequence when booking is within 24 hours.
templates.estimatedROI: Reduces no-shows by 20–35% with automated reminder cadence

templates.name: Real Estate Lead Qualifier
templates.description: Scores inbound leads with Claude (1–10), routes hot leads to agent SMS, warm leads to drip, and cold leads to auto-reply — all logged in Sheets.
templates.estimatedROI: Responds to 100% of leads within minutes; prioritizes high-intent prospects

templates.name: Review Generation
templates.description: Daily schedule or manual webhook pulls completed services from Sheets, sends Claude-personalized review SMS, tracks sends, and emails after 48h with no response.
templates.estimatedROI: Generates 3–5 new reviews per month with minimal staff time

templates.name: Social Content Pipeline
templates.description: Monday morning Claude draft of five posts, Airtable approval queue, and Buffer publish on approval webhook.
templates.estimatedROI: Consistent weekly social presence without a dedicated content hire

templates.name: Invoice Follow-Up
templates.description: QuickBooks webhook starts escalating AR emails at day 3, 7 (with call note), and 14 (formal notice + owner flag) with Sheets logging.
templates.estimatedROI: Accelerates collections by 8–12 days on average

templates.name: Monthly Client Report
templates.description: First-of-month job aggregates GA4, HubSpot, and custom KPIs; Claude writes narrative; PDF service renders; email to client with log.
templates.estimatedROI: Saves 3–5 hours of manual reporting per client per month
